item.title: Councils Rank Among Worst for Road Repairs
item.description: Councils in the HFM region have been named among the worst in the country for pothole repairs and road maintenance. Under a new government traffic-light system, Leicestershire County Council and West Northamptonshire Council are among 13 authorities to have been given the lowest, 'red' rating.
